_comment: PLAIN CRAFTING, NOT blueprint_crafting (owner, 2026-09-06). The two terminals used to
sit behind a Blueprint taught by tearing down a Broken Terminal. Once the market became
the only source of knowledge that deadlocked a fresh world: you would have needed the
Buy Terminal to buy the Buy Terminal's own sheet, and the Sell Terminal to earn any
scrip at all. The entry to the economy cannot sit behind the economy.
Craftable rather than carved out of the market rule, so that rule keeps no exceptions.
The two patterns still differ so they cannot collide at the bench.
